Name: CP Penny Expanded
Author: Cookien00b
Description:
[size=6][CP] Penny Expanded
[/size][size=5]
Details[/size]
This mod is a content patcher version of the mod made by Wolvenlight. [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1372]OG Penny expanded
[/url]﻿
Penny is just so adorable. Always nice and kind. This mod seeks to expand upon that.

This mod adds new dialogue for both Penny and Pam. Most of the dialogue﻿ is for after marriage.

This mod even adds new events. Most of these are for penny, but some are for Pam too.
All the events try to stay close to the vanilla feel of stardew valley. Some events try to change it a bit too. If you have any feedback on any of the events being either good or bad, let me know.

[size=5]FAQ[/size]
[size=3][i]Do I need to start a new farm for this mod to work?
[/i][/size]No, this is not needed. All the new events and dialogue will still work. Just beware that the order of which you see the events will be scrambled.
If this bothers you, I suggest starting a new farm to get the full experience.

[size=3][i]Can this mod be used alongside other mods?
[/i][/size]Yes, this is possible though, I cannot guarantee that the mods will play kindly with each other.

[size=5]The future[/size]
[size=2]What does the future hold? The current release is 0.9.0.
[/size]This is because one event has not been implemented yet. I plan on releasing it later once I decide on how to initiate it.
I will also rewrite some of the events regarding Gunther, as he is quite a douche as of now.
